d: Garment workers in Bangladesh took to the streets on November 24, blocking roads and clashing with law enforcement personnel during protests demanding higher wages. Workers are seeking a monthly minimum wage of 30,000 taka, more than double the current 12,500 taka. However, garment manufacturers are reportedly considering a proposal for just a 15% increase. The ongoing unrest has triggered factory shutdowns and violence, threatening an industry that employs over 4 million people and accounts for more than 80% of Bangladesh's export earnings.
